verified_facts.text: Nobu Hotel Marbella sits on Marbella's Golden Mile in Southern Spain, steps from the sandy beaches of the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the exclusive Golden Mile in Southern Spain, our hotel is steps from the sandy beaches and turquoise waters of the Mediterranean.

verified_facts.text: The hotel pairs Andalusian charm with Nobu's signature Japanese aesthetic.
verified_facts.excerpt: Costa del Sol sunshine and Andalusian charm meet Nobu’s signature Japanese aesthetic and iconic cuisine along Marbella’s glamorous Golden Mile

verified_facts.text: The hotel is part of the Puente Romano resort.
verified_facts.excerpt:
The brand’s Spanish outpost forms part of the sprawling
Puente Romano resort

verified_facts.text: Rooms have brown marble bathrooms, minimal lines and lots of wood, with linen furnishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Eastern-leaning brown marble bathrooms, minimal lines and lots of wood, while linen furnishings and a scattering of cushions bring you back to the Med.

verified_facts.text: Balconies look over the resort's rooftops or, in some rooms, across the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Balconies showcase views over the resort’s rooftops or, if you’re lucky, across the sea.

verified_facts.text: Rooms come with Japanese yukata robes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Japanese yukata robes

verified_facts.text: Six Senses Spa offers treatments in traditional treatment rooms, canopied cabana rooms, or by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Six Senses Spa offers a holistic approach to wellness and a distinct Mediterranean healing experience in traditional treatment rooms, breezy canopied cabana rooms, or by the sea with stunning views.

verified_facts.text: The spa's hammam has herbal and regular steam rooms, a sauna, hot-and-cold therapy showers and various hydrotherapy pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: with herbal and regular steam rooms and sauna, hot-and-cold therapy showers, and various hydrotherapy pools

verified_facts.text: The resort's tennis club has 8 clay courts, 2 plexipave courts and 4 padel courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: The facilities boast 8 clay courts, 2 plexipave courts, and 4 Padel courts.

verified_facts.text: The tennis club offers coaching with a pro and friendly matches with other guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: the resort’s tennis club, a favourite with stars of the game, is the place for a coaching session with a pro, lively mix-ins with other guests

verified_facts.text: The fitness facility has Technogym equipment and a private studio for spin, barre and boxing classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a private health sanctuary featuring Technogym equipment and a private studio for spin, barre, and boxing classes.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers daily complimentary classes, including yoga and Pilates.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our daily complimentary classes , including yoga and Pilates

verified_facts.text: Nobu Marbella serves Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's signature dishes, including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi, at a sushi bar, in the dining room or on a terrace overlooking La Plaza.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy signature dishes, including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Sashimi ... at the intimate sushi bar, in the minimalist elegance of the dining room, or on the Nobu Terrace overlooking La Plaza.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to La Plaza, a fine dining and nightlife scene set along the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests will also enjoy access to La Plaza, the city’s fine dining and nightlife scene set along the Mediterranean Sea.

verified_facts.text: Service follows Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thoughtful, attentive service infused with Omotenashi, the Japanese spirit of hospitality.

verified_facts.text: La Casita Kids Club runs a daily activities program, including tennis coaching, art masterclasses and cooking lessons, including Nobu sushi workshops.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Casita Kids Club runs a daily activities program, including tennis coaching, art masterclasses, and cooking lessons (including Nobu sushi workshops)

verified_facts.text: The Teen Spirit Lounge serves guests aged 13 to 18, with a poolside diner and games including pool, chess and backgammon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serving guests aged 13 to 18, the Teen Spirit Lounge has a poolside diner, and games to practice including pool, chess, and backgammon.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes pets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, we warmly welcome pets.

verified_facts.text: Contactless check-in and check-out are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Contactless check-in and check-out are available.

verified_facts.text: There are some ramps throughout the resort, but many rooms are reached by stairs alone.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are some ramps throughout the resort, but a lot of rooms are only accessible via stairs.

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler advises booking spa treatments in advance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Book spa treatments in advance to avoid disappointment

verified_facts.text: A local farmer tends the hotel's own organic market garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: A local farmer tends the hotel’s own organic market garden

verified_facts.text: The hotel won in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Condé Nast Traveler Readers’ Choice Awards 2026 – Winner
